act_name: Andhra Pradesh Buildings (Lease, Rent and Eviction) Control Act, 1960 (existing tenancies) alongside the Andhra Pradesh Residential and Non-Residential Premises Tenancy Act, 2017 (new tenancies)
note: AP runs a dual regime: the 1960 Rent Control Act continues to govern pre-existing tenancies, while the 2017 Tenancy Act (modelled on the government's earlier 2015 draft tenancy framework, predating the 2021 MTA) applies to tenancies created after its commencement.

act_name: Arunachal Pradesh Tenancy Act, 2022 (Act No. 17 of 2022)
note: Notified in the state gazette in November 2022 on the framework of the Central Model Tenancy Act (Rent Authority/Court/Tribunal structure), though 2025 local reporting says enforcement and rules remain weak, with informal agreements still common.

act_name: Assam Tenancy Act, 2021
note: Assam adapted the Central Model Tenancy Act, 2021 essentially without amendment, becoming the first Indian state to adopt it; it repealed the Assam Urban Areas Rent Control Act, 1972.

act_name: Bihar Buildings (Lease, Rent and Eviction) Control Act, 1982
note: Bihar's core rent-control and eviction-protection statute for private residential and commercial buildings, in force since 1983 and still the operative law; no Model Tenancy Act adoption found.

act_name: Chhattisgarh Rent Control Act, 2011
note: Enacted after Chhattisgarh's split from Madhya Pradesh to regulate rent fixation, written tenancy agreements and disputes via a Rent Controller/Tribunal; remains the governing law, no MTA adoption found.

act_name: Goa, Daman and Diu Buildings (Lease, Rent and Eviction) Control Act, 1968
note: Still Goa's operative rent-control law, most recently amended by the Goa Buildings (Lease, Rent and Eviction) Control (Amendment) Act, 2024; no Model Tenancy Act adoption found.

act_name: Gujarat Rents, Hotel and Lodging House Rates Control Act, 1947
note: Gujarat has repeatedly extended (most recently through March 2026) rather than replaced this 1947 rent-control law; a proposed model-tenancy-style replacement has been discussed since 2019 but has not been enacted.

act_name: Haryana Urban (Control of Rent and Eviction) Act, 1973
note: Remains Haryana's governing rent-control statute for urban areas (excluding cantonments and buildings under 10 years old); the state has confirmedly not adopted the Model Tenancy Act, 2021.

act_name: Himachal Pradesh Urban Rent Control Act, 1987
note: Governs rent and eviction control in HP's urban areas, in force with amendments as recent as 2012; no Model Tenancy Act adoption found.

act_name: Jharkhand Building (Lease, Rent & Eviction) Control Act, 2011
note: Regulates letting, rent and eviction and bars premiums or advance rent beyond one month; current operative law, no Model Tenancy Act adoption found.

act_name: Karnataka Rent Act, 1999
note: Applies to residential/non-residential premises with rent up to about Rs. 3,500/month (higher-rent tenancies fall outside it); recently amended (2024-25) to decriminalise violations and raise fines, rather than being replaced by the Model Tenancy Act.

act_name: Kerala Buildings (Lease and Rent Control) Act, 1965
note: Applies only within municipal/corporation limits (panchayat-area lettings fall under the Transfer of Property Act and the rental contract instead); Kerala has explicitly not adopted the Model Tenancy Act, 2021.

act_name: Madhya Pradesh Accommodation Control Act, 1961
note: Continues to govern letting, rent-fixation and eviction disputes in MP through Rent Controlling Authorities; no repeal or Model Tenancy Act adoption found in current sources.

act_name: Maharashtra Rent Control Act, 1999
note: Maharashtra's principal rent-control statute (replacing the old Bombay Rents Act); remains in force, no Model Tenancy Act adoption found.

Unable to verify. Multiple targeted searches turned up no named Manipur rent-control or tenancy statute; general sources suggest ordinary contract law/Transfer of Property Act likely applies by default, but this needs manual confirmation rather than being asserted.

act_name: Meghalaya Urban Areas Rent Control Act, 1972 (as amended)
note: Governs tenant security of tenure and eviction grounds in Meghalaya's urban areas; remains the applicable law, no Model Tenancy Act adoption found.

act_name: Mizoram Urban Areas Rent Control Act, 1974
note: Covers fair-rent fixation (revisable only every 5 years once fixed by a court) and eviction in Mizoram's urban areas; no Model Tenancy Act adoption found.

Nagaland has no rent-control or tenancy statute in force - the state's own government portal only hosts a draft Model Tenancy Act that has not been enacted - so tenancies are governed primarily by the landlord-tenant contract itself.

act_name: Orissa (Odisha) House Rent Control Act, 1967
note: Still the operative law; a Draft Odisha Urban Area Rent Control Act, 2026 (modelled on the Model Tenancy Act) has been published for consultation but is not yet enacted.

act_name: Punjab Rent Act, 1995
note: Replaced the East Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Act, 1949 and took effect in 2013; remains Punjab's governing rent-control law, no Model Tenancy Act adoption found.

act_name: Rajasthan Rent Control Act, 2001
note: Governs tenancy agreements, rent revision and eviction via a Rent Authority; amended in 2017 to mandate written/registered agreements. No Model Tenancy Act adoption found.

Sikkim has no comprehensive statewide rent-control law; only the narrow, decades-old Gangtok Rent Control and Eviction Act, 1956 applies to the Gangtok Bazaar area specifically. Most tenancies are governed by ordinary contract law.

act_name: Tamil Nadu Regulation of Rights and Responsibilities of Landlords and Tenants Act, 2017
note: Repealed the older Tamil Nadu Buildings (Lease and Rent Control) Act, 1960 and was enacted on the lines of the government's earlier (2015) draft model-tenancy framework, requiring written, registered tenancy agreements.

act_name: Telangana Buildings (Lease, Rent and Eviction) Control Act, 1960
note: Carried over from undivided Andhra Pradesh via the Telangana Adaptation of Laws Order, 2016; remains in force, and the Model Tenancy Act, 2021 has explicitly not been adopted in the state.

act_name: Tripura Buildings (Lease and Rent Control) Act, 1975 (Act No. 5 of 1975)
note: Tripura's rent-control statute governing leased buildings; no Model Tenancy Act adoption found.

act_name: Uttar Pradesh Regulation of Urban Premises Tenancy Act, 2021 (Act No. 16 of 2021)
note: Modelled explicitly on the Central Model Tenancy Act; replaced the UP Urban Buildings (Regulation of Letting, Rent and Eviction) Act, 1972 and established a Rent Authority/Tribunal system.

act_name: Uttarakhand Tenancy Act, 2021
note: Replaced the inherited UP Urban Buildings Act, 1972 that remained in force after Uttarakhand's 2000 bifurcation; modelled on the Central Model Tenancy Act framework with a Rent Authority and mandatory registered tenancy agreements.

act_name: West Bengal Premises Tenancy Act, 1997
note: Applies to Kolkata, Howrah and other notified municipal areas of WB; amended multiple times between 2005 and 2010. No Model Tenancy Act adoption found.

act_name: Andaman and Nicobar Islands Tenancy Regulation, 2023 (No. 2 of 2023)
note: A Presidential Regulation under Article 240 applying the Model Tenancy Act framework to the islands; promulgated in 2023 but, per 2025-26 local reporting, still awaiting the gazette notification and rules needed for actual implementation.

act_name: East Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Act, 1949 (extended to Chandigarh, amended 1982)
note: Chandigarh follows this 1949 Punjab-origin rent law rather than the Punjab Rent Act 1995 or Delhi's 1958 Act; Model Tenancy Act not adopted.

jurisdiction: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
act_name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu Tenancy Regulation, 2023
note: A Presidential regulation under Article 240 applying a Model-Tenancy-Act-style framework (Rent Authority, agreed rent, dispute resolution) across the UT, superseding the older Buildings (Lease, Rent & Eviction) Control Act, 1968 as locally applied.

act_name: Delhi Rent Control Act, 1958
note: Applies only where monthly rent is Rs. 3,500 or less; most modern tenancies fall outside it and are governed by general contract law instead.

act_name: Jammu and Kashmir Tenancy Act, 2025 (Act No. 4 of 2025)
note: Passed by the J&K Legislative Assembly in October 2025 and assented to by the Lieutenant Governor on 1 November 2025; establishes a Rent Authority on Model-Tenancy-Act lines and repeals the Jammu and Kashmir (Residential and Commercial Tenancy) Act, 2012.

act_name: Ladakh Tenancy Regulation, 2024
note: Repealed the Jammu and Kashmir (Residential and Commercial Tenancy) Act, 2012 as it applied to Ladakh, introducing a Rent Authority and deposit-with-authority dispute mechanism similar to the Model Tenancy Act.

act_name: Lakshadweep Tenancy Regulation, 2023
note: A Presidential regulation under Article 240 adopting the Model Tenancy Act framework (Rent Authority, agreed rent, prescribed payment and notice rules) for the UT.

act_name: Puducherry Buildings (Lease and Rent Control) Act, 1969
note: Regulates leasing and rent of residential/non-residential buildings in Puducherry (government premises excluded); still in force with amendments (e.g., Act 8 of 1980). No Model Tenancy Act adoption found.
